THE DECORATIVE COLUMNS ARE ROUND AND TAPERED: ø0.32 at the lower storey, ø0.28 above, with moulded caps and bases (0.05 / 0.025 / 0.19). They are the columns visible on the cover perspective and on the elevations. Note the STRUCTURAL columns behind them are C1 at 0.15x0.15 (S-03) - these round profiles are a plaster casing, not the structural section, which is why they are recorded here as architectural elements and NOT joined to C1's spec.
The 1.60 m bottom dimension is the ข-to-ก grid distance and matches the master exactly. The 3.10 m vertical is the floor-to-อะเส height, agreeing with A-06's 3.10 chain segment.
